hero.title: Websites with clear structure, premium design and transparent planning.
hero.description: Every project is individual. Our prices serve as transparent orientation — the final scope depends on goals, structure, design level and required functionality.

priceFactors.title: What influences the price?
priceFactors.description: The starting price gives a first orientation. The final scope depends on how large the website will be, which functions are needed and how individually the design should be developed.

items.title: Scope
items.description: A compact landing page is planned faster than a multi-page business website with many content sections.

items.title: Functions
items.description: Forms, multilingual content, bookings, shops or special areas increase the technical effort.

items.title: Design level
items.description: The more individual, premium and brand-specific the website should feel, the more intensive the design work becomes.

packages.title: Clear website solutions for different goals.
packages.description: Whether it is a landing page, a small business website, a professional business presence, a premium website or an online shop — our packages give you clear orientation. The final price depends on scope and requirements.

items.name: Landing Page
items.shortDescription: For a single service, offer, campaign or a fast professional start.
items.idealFor: Ideal for freelancers, experts, local offers, events, campaigns or individual services.
items.suitableFor: You want to become professionally visible quickly and present one specific offer clearly.
items.notSuitableFor: You need several subpages, complex functions, a shop or a larger content structure.

items.name: Website for Small Businesses
items.shortDescription: For small companies, studios and local service providers that want a professional online presence.
items.idealFor: Ideal for small companies, practices, beauty studios, craftsmen, coaches, cafés or local service providers.
items.suitableFor: You need a serious company website with the most important information, services and contact options.
items.notSuitableFor: You are planning a larger website with many subpages, strong brand strategy or complex functions.

items.name: Business Website
items.shortDescription: For companies, service providers and brands that want to build trust and generate inquiries online.
items.idealFor: Ideal for companies, agencies, studios, real estate, consulting, medical, education and professional services.
items.suitableFor: Your website should not only inform, but also sell professionally, build trust and attract new customers.
items.notSuitableFor: You only need a very simple online business card or a single campaign page.

items.name: Premium Website
items.shortDescription: For brands that want to appear premium, modern and distinctive online.
items.idealFor: Ideal for premium brands, growing companies and custom websites with a strong design focus.
items.suitableFor: Your website should feel like a high-quality digital brand experience and clearly stand out from standard websites.
items.notSuitableFor: You are looking for a very simple solution without strategy, special design or individual details.

items.name: Online Shop / Platform
items.shortDescription: For shops, platforms, booking systems and individual digital solutions.
items.idealFor: Ideal for online shops, portals, platforms, booking systems, member areas or more complex web applications.
items.suitableFor: You need more than a classic website and are planning functions, processes, sales or special user areas.
items.notSuitableFor: You only need a simple presentation page or a small company website without special technical functions.

customSolution.title: No package fits your project exactly?
customSolution.description: Not every project fits into a fixed package. If you need a special website, platform, booking solution, online shop, member area or individual functions, we create a personal offer tailored to your goals.
customSolution.note: Price according to scope and requirements. Together, we check which solution really makes sense.

subscription.title: Professional website with monthly payment and support.
subscription.description: Ideal for businesses that do not want to pay the full project price at once. You pay a one-time setup fee and then a monthly amount including technical support and small adjustments.
subscription.note: One-time setup + monthly payment. Minimum term: 24 months. After the term ends, the website belongs to you. Support can be continued if desired.

items.name: Abo Start
items.description: For compact landing pages and small digital presences.

items.name: Abo Business
items.description: For small companies, studios and local service providers.

items.name: Abo Premium
items.description: For brands that want regular development and improvement.

redesign.title: When your current website no longer matches your standards.
redesign.description: Many businesses already have a website — but it looks outdated, unclear or not convincing enough. We analyze existing websites and turn them into modern, high-quality and user-friendly digital presences.

additionalServices.title: Flexible modules for special requirements.
additionalServices.description: Not every project needs the same services. Depending on your goals, additional modules may be useful.

items.name: Website Audit
items.description: Analysis of design, structure, user experience, mobile experience and optimization potential.

items.name: SEO Basic Setup
items.description: Technical and structural SEO foundation for better visibility.

items.name: Website Copy
items.description: Clear, professional and persuasive copy for important website sections.

items.name: Multilingual Setup
items.description: Additional language versions for international or multilingual target groups.

items.name: Branding Light
items.description: Color direction, font combination, moodboard and visual foundation for the website.

items.name: Conversion Optimization
items.description: Optimization of user flow, CTA areas, forms and trust elements.

items.name: Website Rescue
items.description: For websites that urgently need technical, visual or structural improvements.

items.name: Small Changes
items.description: Small adjustments to existing pages, content or sections.

care.title: After launch, your website remains in good hands.
care.description: If desired, we continue supporting your website — technically, visually and strategically.

items.name: Care Basic
items.description: For small websites that should remain technically maintained.

items.name: Care Growth
items.description: For businesses that want to improve their website regularly.

items.name: Care Premium
items.description: For brands that want to actively develop their website further.

items.question: Why are there no fixed final prices?
items.answer: Because every website has different goals, content and functions. The prices shown are orientation values. After a short conversation, you receive an individual offer.

items.question: Can I start small and expand later?
items.answer: Yes. Many projects start with a clear landing page or compact website and are expanded later.

items.question: Is SEO included?
items.answer: A technical and structural SEO foundation is included. Extended SEO strategy, SEO content and ongoing optimization can be booked additionally.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A landing page usually takes approx. 4–6 weeks. A small business website usually takes approx. 6–8 weeks. For business websites, premium websites, shops and platforms, the timeline is discussed individually based on scope and requirements.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Our care packages help keep your website maintained, current and ready for further development.

items.question: Do I own the website after the subscription?
items.answer: Yes. After the minimum term ends, the website belongs to you. Technical support can be continued flexibly if desired.
